assumptions_metadata.task_description: Generate validated post-match summaries and update league standings for a professional T20 cricket analytics platform.

assumptions.assumption: team1 and team2 must be different teams.
toss_winner must be either team1 or team2.
team1 and team2 values are drawn from the league’s historical roster (~19 distinct teams).
If result = 'runs', result_margin must be between 1 and 200.
If result = 'wickets', result_margin must be between 1 and 10.
If result ∈ {'tie','no result'}, result_margin must be null.
At least 95% of matches have result ∈ {'runs','wickets'}.
If result = 'tie', super_over must be 'Y'.
If result = 'tie', winner must be non-null (decided via Super Over).
If result = 'no result', winner must be null.
If result ∈ {'runs','wickets'}, super_over must be 'N'.
If result ∈ {'runs','wickets'}, winner must be non-null.
toss_decision must be either 'bat' or 'field'.
If result = 'wickets' and toss_decision = 'field', winner must equal toss_winner (chasing side won).
If result = 'wickets' and toss_decision = 'bat', winner must not equal toss_winner (non-toss side chased and won).
If result = 'runs' and toss_decision = 'bat', winner must equal toss_winner (defending side won).
If result = 'runs' and toss_decision = 'field', winner must not equal toss_winner (team that batted first was not the toss winner).
target_overs must be > 0 and ≤ 20.0 for T20.
If method = 'D/L', target_overs must be < 20.0.
If method is null (no D/L), target_overs must equal 20.0.
target_runs must be between 1 and 301.
At least 90% of matches have target_overs = 20.0.
method must be either 'D/L' or null.
date must be parseable in YYYY-MM-DD format.
season must equal the calendar year extracted from date.
season must be within [2008, 2024].
Each season must have exactly one match with match_type = 'Final'.
At least 90% of matches should have match_type = 'League'.
match_type must be one of {'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Semi Final','Final','3rd Place Play-Off','Elimination Final'}.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Normalize dtypes used downstream
if df['season'].dtype != 'int64' and df['season'].dtype != 'int32':
    df['season'] = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')

# Parse dates for seasonal validation and downstream grouping
df['date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['date_dt'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
season_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
assert season_numeric.notna().all()
assert ((season_numeric.astype(int) == df['date_dt'].dt.year).all())
assert ((season_numeric >= 2008) & (season_numeric <= 2024)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

df['season'] = season_numeric.astype(int)

# Team and toss validations used to derive batted_first/chasing teams
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_toss_winner_member = (df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])
assert mask_toss_winner_member.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derive batted_first and chasing_team, guarded by assertions above
other_of_toss = np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
df['batted_first'] = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', df['toss_winner'], other_of_toss)
df['chasing_team'] = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'field', df['toss_winner'], other_of_toss)

# Result/result_margin rules before producing textual summaries and standings
# ASSERTION_START
runs_mask = df['result'] == 'runs'
wkts_mask = df['result'] == 'wickets'
tie_mask = df['result'] == 'tie'
nr_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
assert ((~runs_mask & ~wkts_mask & ~tie_mask & ~nr_mask).sum() == 0)
assert (df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin'].notna()).all()
assert (df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin'].notna()).all()
if runs_mask.any():
    rm = df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert ((rm >= 1) & (rm <= 200)).all()
if wkts_mask.any():
    rm = df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert ((rm >= 1) & (rm <= 10)).all()
if (tie_mask | nr_mask).any():
    assert df.loc[tie_mask | nr_mask, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
frac_rw = (runs_mask | wkts_mask).mean()
assert frac_rw >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

# Result/winner/super_over coupling used in summary rendering and points allocation
# ASSERTION_START
if tie_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[tie_mask, 'super_over'] == 'Y').all()
    assert df.loc[tie_mask, 'winner'].notna().all()
if nr_mask.any():
    assert df.loc[nr_mask, 'winner'].isna().all()
if (runs_mask | wkts_mask).any():
    assert (df.loc[runs_mask | wkts_mask, 'super_over'] == 'N').all()
    assert df.loc[runs_mask | wkts_mask, 'winner'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Toss decision implies batting/chasing outcomes; used to compute strategy fields
# ASSERTION_START
if wkts_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[wkts_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[wkts_mask, 'chasing_team']).all()
if runs_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[runs_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[runs_mask, 'batted_first']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# target_overs/target_runs/method rules before calculating required run rate
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['method'].dropna().isin(['D/L']).all()
assert df['target_overs'].notna().all()
assert df['target_runs'].notna().all()
assert ((df['target_overs'] > 0) & (df['target_overs'] <= 20.0)).all()
assert ((df['target_runs'] >= 1) & (df['target_runs'] <= 301)).all()
if df['method'].isna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df['method'].isna(), 'target_overs'] == 20.0).all()
if df['method'].notna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df['method'].notna(), 'target_overs'] < 20.0).all()
assert (df['target_overs'] == 20.0).mean() >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# match_type expectations used to identify season champions
allowed_match_types = {
    'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Semi Final','Final','3rd Place Play-Off','Elimination Final'
}
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['match_type'].isin(allowed_match_types).all()
assert (df['match_type'] == 'League').mean() >= 0.90
final_counts = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'].groupby('season').size()
all_seasons = df['season'].unique()
missing_final = set(all_seasons) - set(final_counts.index)
assert len(missing_final) == 0
assert (final_counts == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Required run rate for context in summaries
df['required_run_rate'] = df['target_runs'] / df['target_overs']

# Build post-match summary text
def format_summary_row(row):
    if row['result'] == 'runs':
        margin = int(row['result_margin'])
        return f"{row['winner']} won by {margin} runs"
    elif row['result'] == 'wickets':
        margin = int(row['result_margin'])
        return f"{row['winner']} won by {margin} wickets"
    elif row['result'] == 'tie':
        return f"{row['winner']} won via Super Over"
    else:
        return "No result"

summaries = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'],
    'date': df['date_dt'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
    'team1': df['team1'],
    'team2': df['team2'],
    'toss_winner': df['toss_winner'],
    'toss_decision': df['toss_decision'],
    'winner': df['winner'],
    'result': df['result'],
    'result_margin': df['result_margin'],
    'method': df['method'],
    'target_runs': df['target_runs'],
    'target_overs': df['target_overs'],
    'required_run_rate': df['required_run_rate'].round(3),
})

summaries['summary'] = df.apply(format_summary_row, axis=1)

# Compute standings per season
home = df[['id','season','team1','team2','winner','result']].copy()
away = df[['id','season','team1','team2','winner','result']].copy()
home['team'] = home['team1']
away['team'] = away['team2']
long_side = pd.concat([
    home[['id','season','team','winner','result']],
    away[['id','season','team','winner','result']]
], ignore_index=True)

long_side['is_win'] = (long_side['team'] == long_side['winner']).astype(int)
long_side['is_nr'] = (long_side['result'] == 'no result').astype(int)

standings = long_side.groupby(['season','team']).agg(
    wins=('is_win','sum'),
    nr=('is_nr','sum'),
    played=('id','count')
).reset_index()
standings['losses'] = standings['played'] - standings['wins'] - standings['nr']
standings['points'] = standings['wins'] * 2 + standings['nr'] * 1

# Champions via the Final
finals = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'][['season','winner']].copy()
# ASSERTION_START
assert finals.groupby('season').size().eq(1).all()
assert finals['winner'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

champions = finals.rename(columns={'winner': 'champion'})

# Write outputs
summaries.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'match_summaries.csv'), index=False)
standings.sort_values(['season','points','wins'], ascending=[True, False, False]).to_csv(
    os.path.join(args.output, 'league_standings.csv'), index=False
)
champions.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'season_champions.csv'), index=False)

If result = 'runs' and toss_decision = 'field', winner must not equal toss_winner (team that batted first was not the toss winner).
target_overs must be > 0 and ≤ 20.0 for T20.
If method = 'D/L', target_overs must be < 20.0.
If method is null (no D/L), target_overs must equal 20.0.
target_runs must be between 1 and 301.
At least 90% of matches have target_overs = 20.0.
method must be either 'D/L' or null.
date must be parseable in YYYY-MM-DD format.
season must equal the calendar year extracted from date.
season must be within [2008, 2024].
Each season must have exactly one match with match_type = 'Final'.
At least 90% of matches should have match_type = 'League'.
match_type must be one of {'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Semi Final','Final','3rd Place Play-Off','Elimination Final'}.

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Normalize dtypes used downstream
if df['season'].dtype != 'int64' and df['season'].dtype != 'int32':
    df['season'] = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')

# Parse dates for seasonal validation and downstream grouping
df['date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['date_dt'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
season_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
assert season_numeric.notna().all()
assert ((season_numeric.astype(int) == df['date_dt'].dt.year).all())
assert ((season_numeric >= 2008) & (season_numeric <= 2024)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

df['season'] = season_numeric.astype(int)

# Team and toss validations used to derive batted_first/chasing teams
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_toss_winner_member = (df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])
assert mask_toss_winner_member.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derive batted_first and chasing_team, guarded by assertions above
other_of_toss = np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
df['batted_first'] = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', df['toss_winner'], other_of_toss)
df['chasing_team'] = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'field', df['toss_winner'], other_of_toss)

# Result/result_margin rules before producing textual summaries and standings
# ASSERTION_START
runs_mask = df['result'] == 'runs'
wkts_mask = df['result'] == 'wickets'
tie_mask = df['result'] == 'tie'
nr_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
assert ((~runs_mask & ~wkts_mask & ~tie_mask & ~nr_mask).sum() == 0)
assert (df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin'].notna()).all()
assert (df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin'].notna()).all()
if runs_mask.any():
    rm = df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert ((rm >= 1) & (rm <= 200)).all()
if wkts_mask.any():
    rm = df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert ((rm >= 1) & (rm <= 10)).all()
if (tie_mask | nr_mask).any():
    assert df.loc[tie_mask | nr_mask, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
frac_rw = (runs_mask | wkts_mask).mean()
assert frac_rw >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

# Result/winner/super_over coupling used in summary rendering and points allocation
# ASSERTION_START
if tie_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[tie_mask, 'super_over'] == 'Y').all()
    assert df.loc[tie_mask, 'winner'].notna().all()
if nr_mask.any():
    assert df.loc[nr_mask, 'winner'].isna().all()
if (runs_mask | wkts_mask).any():
    assert (df.loc[runs_mask | wkts_mask, 'super_over'] == 'N').all()
    assert df.loc[runs_mask | wkts_mask, 'winner'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Toss decision implies batting/chasing outcomes; used to compute strategy fields
# ASSERTION_START
if wkts_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[wkts_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[wkts_mask, 'chasing_team']).all()
if runs_mask.any():
    assert (df.loc[runs_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[runs_mask, 'batted_first']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# target_overs/target_runs/method rules before calculating required run rate
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['method'].dropna().isin(['D/L']).all()
assert df['target_overs'].notna().all()
assert df['target_runs'].notna().all()
assert ((df['target_overs'] > 0) & (df['target_overs'] <= 20.0)).all()
assert ((df['target_runs'] >= 1) & (df['target_runs'] <= 301)).all()
if df['method'].isna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df['method'].isna(), 'target_overs'] == 20.0).all()
if df['method'].notna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df['method'].notna(), 'target_overs'] < 20.0).all()
assert (df['target_overs'] == 20.0).mean() >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# match_type expectations used to identify season champions
allowed_match_types = {
    'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Semi Final','Final','3rd Place Play-Off','Elimination Final'
}
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['match_type'].isin(allowed_match_types).all()
assert (df['match_type'] == 'League').mean() >= 0.90
final_counts = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'].groupby('season').size()
all_seasons = df['season'].unique()
missing_final = set(all_seasons) - set(final_counts.index)
assert len(missing_final) == 0
assert (final_counts == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Required run rate for context in summaries
df['required_run_rate'] = df['target_runs'] / df['target_overs']

# Build post-match summary text
def format_summary_row(row):
    if row['result'] == 'runs':
        margin = int(row['result_margin'])
        return f"{row['winner']} won by {margin} runs"
    elif row['result'] == 'wickets':
        margin = int(row['result_margin'])
        return f"{row['winner']} won by {margin} wickets"
    elif row['result'] == 'tie':
        return f"{row['winner']} won via Super Over"
    else:
        return "No result"

summaries = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'],
    'date': df['date_dt'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
    'team1': df['team1'],
    'team2': df['team2'],
    'toss_winner': df['toss_winner'],
    'toss_decision': df['toss_decision'],
    'winner': df['winner'],
    'result': df['result'],
    'result_margin': df['result_margin'],
    'method': df['method'],
    'target_runs': df['target_runs'],
    'target_overs': df['target_overs'],
    'required_run_rate': df['required_run_rate'].round(3),
})

summaries['summary'] = df.apply(format_summary_row, axis=1)

# Compute standings per season
home = df[['id','season','team1','team2','winner','result']].copy()
away = df[['id','season','team1','team2','winner','result']].copy()
home['team'] = home['team1']
away['team'] = away['team2']
long_side = pd.concat([
    home[['id','season','team','winner','result']],
    away[['id','season','team','winner','result']]
], ignore_index=True)

long_side['is_win'] = (long_side['team'] == long_side['winner']).astype(int)
long_side['is_nr'] = (long_side['result'] == 'no result').astype(int)

standings = long_side.groupby(['season','team']).agg(
    wins=('is_win','sum'),
    nr=('is_nr','sum'),
    played=('id','count')
).reset_index()
standings['losses'] = standings['played'] - standings['wins'] - standings['nr']
standings['points'] = standings['wins'] * 2 + standings['nr'] * 1

# Champions via the Final
finals = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'][['season','winner']].copy()
# ASSERTION_START
assert finals.groupby('season').size().eq(1).all()
assert finals['winner'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

champions = finals.rename(columns={'winner': 'champion'})

# Write outputs
summaries.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'match_summaries.csv'), index=False)
standings.sort_values(['season','points','wins'], ascending=[True, False, False]).to_csv(
    os.path.join(args.output, 'league_standings.csv'), index=False
)
champions.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'season_champions.csv'), index=False)
